subject: history
title: Akbar's Conquests (1560-1601)
description: Complete table of Akbar's military conquests with years and opponents

content.overview: Akbar (reigned 1556-1605) expanded the Mughal Empire through a series of military conquests across India. Here is the complete list of his conquests.
keyPoints: 1564: Gondwana (Gadh Katanga) — Rani Durgawati (regent of Bir Narayan)
1570: Marwar — Chandrasena, Kalyanmal, Raj Singh, Rawal Harirai
1585-86: Kashmir — Yusuf Khan and Yakub Khan
1590-92: Orissa — Kutul Khan and Nisar Khan
1597-1600: Ahmadnagar — Chand Bibi (regent of Bahadur Shah)

mnemonics.trick: Haldighati 1576 = Rana Pratap | Chittor 1568 = Rana Uday Singh | Gujarat 1572 = Bahadur Shah | Bengal 1574-76 = Daud Khan Karrani
mnemonics.explanation: Most-asked conquests: Haldighati (1576, Rana Pratap), Chittor (1568, Uday Singh), Gujarat (1572, Bahadur Shah), Bengal-Bihar (1574-76, Daud Khan Karrani)
Two famous women defenders against Akbar: Rani Durgawati of Gondwana (regent of Bir Narayan, 1564) and Chand Bibi of Ahmadnagar (regent of Bahadur Shah, 1597-1600)

mnemonics.trick: 1560s = North/Central (Malwa, Chunar, Merta, Gondwana, Chittor, Ranthambhor, Kalinjar) | 1570s = West/East (Marwar, Gujarat, Bengal, Haldighati) | 1580s-90s = North-West/South (Kabul, Kashmir, Sindh, Orissa, Khandesh, Baluchistan, Kandhar, Ahmadnagar, Asirgarh)
mnemonics.explanation: Chronological spread: 1560s central India, 1570s Gujarat/Bengal/Rajputana, 1580s-1601 north-west frontier and Deccan

quiz.question: The Battle of Haldighati (1576) was fought between Akbar's forces and:
quiz.explanation: The Battle of Haldighati (1576) was fought against Rana Pratap of Mewar

quiz.question: Rani Durgawati defended which kingdom against Akbar?
quiz.explanation: Rani Durgawati defended Gondwana (Gadh Katanga) in 1564 as regent of Bir Narayan

quiz.question: Chand Bibi defended Ahmadnagar against Akbar in:
quiz.explanation: Chand Bibi defended Ahmadnagar (1597-1600) as regent of Bahadur Shah

quiz.question: Akbar's last major conquest was:
quiz.explanation: Asirgarh (1601) was Akbar's last major conquest, against Miran Bahadur Khan
